title: A City of Many Cultures
text:
Our city is full of people from many countries. Every month, families come together for a festival. People wear different clothes and cook different food. This makes the city colorful and interesting.

At the festival, children learn songs from other cultures. Some visitors bring traditional dances from their homeland. Everyone shares a meal at long tables in the park. Many people say that cultural diversity makes them more open-minded.

questions.text: How often do families come together for a festival?
What do children learn at the festival?
What can we infer about the city?
options: It has people with many different backgrounds
It is very small and quiet

questions.text: Why do many people think the festival is valuable?

having many bright colors or interesting differences
passed down from older generations and still practiced
the country where a person was born or comes from

paragraph_translations: Şehrimiz birçok ülkeden insanlarla doludur. Her ay aileler bir festival için bir araya gelir. İnsanlar farklı kıyafetler giyer ve farklı yemekler pişirir. Bu durum şehri renkli ve ilginç hale getirir.

Festivalde çocuklar başka kültürlerden şarkılar öğrenir. Bazı ziyaretçiler anavatanlarından geleneksel danslar getirir. Herkes parkta uzun masalarda birlikte yemek yer. Birçok insan kültürel çeşitliliğin onları daha açık fikirli yaptığını söyler.
